tables.description:
Synthetic patient demographic and financial records generated by Synthea (MITRE Corporation). Mirrors real clinical data distributions. Contains 12,352 patients.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- id: UUID patient identifier. All other tables reference patients using this column (encounters.patient, conditions.patient, medications.patient, procedures.patient, allergies.patient)
- birthdate: date of birth (TEXT, e.g. '1965-03-22')
- deathdate: date of death — NULL if patient is alive. Use 'deathdate IS NOT NULL' for deceased patients
- first, last: patient name
- race: 'white', 'black', 'asian', 'native', 'other'
- ethnicity: 'nonhispanic', 'hispanic'
- gender: 'M' or 'F'
- birthplace: city, state, country of birth
- city, state, zip: patient address (US states, e.g. 'Massachusetts', 'New York')
- healthcare_expenses: total out-of-pocket costs in USD
- healthcare_coverage: total insurance coverage received in USD
- income: annual household income in USD

COMMON QUERY PATTERNS (SQLite):
- Patient age: CAST((JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(birthdate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER)
- Deceased patients: WHERE deathdate IS NOT NULL
- Living patients: WHERE deathdate IS NULL
- Gender distribution: COUNT(*) GROUP BY gender
- Average cost: AVG(healthcare_expenses)

SAMPLE QUESTIONS:
- How many patients are in the dataset?
- What is the gender distribution of patients?
- What is the average healthcare cost per patient?
- How many patients died during the recorded period?
- Which state has the most patients?

Clinical encounter records — every time a patient visited a healthcare provider. Contains 321,528 encounters. This is the central fact table for healthcare cost analysis.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- id: unique encounter UUID. Referenced by conditions.encounter, medications.encounter, procedures.encounter, allergies.encounter
- start, stop: encounter start/end timestamps (TEXT, e.g. '2020-03-15T10:30:00Z')
- patient: UUID linking to patients.id
- organization: healthcare facility name
- provider: individual provider UUID
- payer: insurance payer UUID
- encounterclass: type of encounter — 'ambulatory' (most common, outpatient clinic), 'wellness' (preventive checkup), 'inpatient' (hospital stay), 'emergency' (ER visit), 'urgentcare', 'outpatient', 'virtual'
- code: SNOMED-CT encounter code
- description: human-readable encounter type (e.g. 'Encounter for check up', 'Emergency room admission')
- base_encounter_cost: base cost before insurance in USD
- total_claim_cost: total billed cost in USD
- payer_coverage: amount covered by insurance in USD
- reasoncode: SNOMED code for the reason for the visit
- reasondescription: human-readable reason (e.g. 'COVID-19', 'Hypertension', 'Diabetes')

COMMON QUERY PATTERNS:
- Average cost by encounter type: AVG(total_claim_cost) GROUP BY encounterclass
- Encounters per patient: COUNT(*) GROUP BY patient
- Payer coverage percentage: AVG(payer_coverage / total_claim_cost * 100)
- Encounters per year: STRFTIME('%Y', start) GROUP BY year
- Average encounters per patient: COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT patient)

Diagnosed medical conditions (diagnoses) for patients. Contains 114,544 records. Multiple conditions per patient are common.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- start: date condition was first diagnosed (TEXT, e.g. '2015-06-10')
- stop: date condition resolved — NULL if condition is chronic/ongoing
- patient: UUID linking to patients.id
- encounter: UUID linking to encounters.id
- code: SNOMED-CT diagnosis code (e.g. '44054006' = Diabetes, '59621000' = Hypertension)
- description: human-readable condition name (e.g. 'Diabetes mellitus type 2', 'Essential hypertension', 'COVID-19', 'Obesity', 'Prediabetes', 'Anemia', 'Asthma', 'Coronary Heart Disease')

COMMON QUERY PATTERNS:
- Top diagnoses: COUNT(*) GROUP BY description ORDER BY count DESC
- Patients with diabetes: WHERE description LIKE '%Diabetes%'
- Patients with a specific condition: COUNT(DISTINCT patient) WHERE description = '...'
- Chronic conditions: WHERE stop IS NULL

Prescription medication records for patients. Contains 431,262 records — the largest table. A patient may have many medication prescriptions over time.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- start: date prescription started
- stop: date prescription ended — NULL if still active
- patient: UUID linking to patients.id
- payer: insurance payer UUID
- encounter: UUID linking to encounters.id
- code: RxNorm medication code
- description: medication name (e.g. 'Penicillin V Potassium', 'Lisinopril', 'Metformin', 'Atorvastatin', 'Amlodipine', 'Insulin')
- base_cost: cost per dispense in USD
- payer_coverage: insurance coverage per dispense in USD
- dispenses: number of times dispensed
- totalcost: total cost = base_cost * dispenses (USD)
- reasoncode: SNOMED code for why medication was prescribed
- reasondescription: condition being treated (e.g. 'Hypertension', 'Diabetes mellitus type 2')

COMMON QUERY PATTERNS:
- Most common medication: COUNT(*) GROUP BY description ORDER BY count DESC
- Unique medications: COUNT(DISTINCT description) or COUNT(DISTINCT code)
- Highest cost conditions: AVG(totalcost) GROUP BY reasondescription
- Active prescriptions: WHERE stop IS NULL

Medical procedures performed on patients during encounters. Contains 100,427 records.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- start, stop: procedure start and end timestamps
- patient: UUID linking to patients.id
- encounter: UUID linking to encounters.id
- code: SNOMED-CT procedure code
- description: procedure name (e.g. 'Measurement of respiratory function', 'Chest X-ray', 'Colonoscopy', 'Depression screening', 'Medication reconciliation', 'Assessment of health and social care needs')
- base_cost: cost of procedure in USD
- reasoncode: SNOMED code for reason
- reasondescription: condition requiring this procedure

COMMON QUERY PATTERNS:
- Top procedures: COUNT(*) GROUP BY description ORDER BY count DESC
- Most expensive procedures: AVG(base_cost) GROUP BY description

Patient allergy records. Contains 5,417 records.

KEY COLUMN SEMANTICS:
- start: date allergy was first recorded
- stop: date allergy was resolved — NULL if still active
- patient: UUID linking to patients.id
- encounter: UUID linking to encounters.id
- code: allergy substance code
- description: allergy substance (e.g. 'Penicillin', 'Peanut', 'House dust mite', 'Tree pollen', 'Animal dander', 'Latex')
- type: allergy classification — 'allergy' or 'intolerance'
- category: substance category — 'medication', 'food', 'environment', 'biologic'
- reaction1: allergic reaction description (e.g. 'Eruption of skin', 'Rhinitis')
- severity1: severity level — 'MILD', 'MODERATE', 'SEVERE'

COMMON QUERY PATTERNS:
- Patients with at least one allergy: COUNT(DISTINCT patient)
- Most common allergy types: COUNT(*) GROUP BY type
- Most common allergens: COUNT(*) GROUP BY description
- By category: COUNT(*) GROUP BY category
